an3.71:1.2: Atha kho Channo paribbājako yen' āyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi
an3.71:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Channo paribbājako āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:
an3.71:1.4: Tumhe pi āvuso Ānanda rāgassa pahānaṃ paññāpetha dosassa . . . pe . . . mohassa pahānaṃ paññāpethā ti.
an3.71:1.5: Mayaṃ kho āvuso rāgassa pahānaṃ paññāpema dosassa . . .x pe . . . mohassa pahānaṃ paññāpemā ti.
an3.71:2.1: Kiṃ pana tumhe āvuso rāge ādīnavaṃ disvā rāgassa pahānaṃ paññāpetha . . . pe . . . kiṃ mohe ādīnavaṃ disvā mohassa pahānaṃ paññāpethā ti? 2.
an3.71:3.1: Ratto kho āvuso rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attavyābādhāya pi ceteti para . . . pe . . . ubhayavyābādhāya pi ceteti cetasikam pi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.71:3.2: Rāge pahīne n' eva attavyābādhāya ceteti na para . . . pe . . . na ubhaya . . . pe . . . na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.71:3.3: Ratto kho āvuso rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, vācāya . . . pe . . . manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.71:3.4: Rāge pahīne n' eva kāyena duccaritaṃ carati na vācāya . . . na manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.71:3.5: Ratto kho āvuso rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attattham pi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti parattham pi . . . pe . . . ubhayattham pi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an3.71:3.6: Rāge pahīne attattham pi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti parattham pi . . . pe . . . ubhayattham pi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. Ratto
an3.71:3.7: kho āvuso andhakaraṇo acakkhukaraṇo aññāṇakaraṇo paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko.
an3.71:4.2: Mūḷho kho āvuso mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attavyābādhāya pi ceteti para . . . pe . . . ubhayavyābādhāya pi ceteti cetasikam pi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.71:4.3: Mohe pahīne n' eva attavyābādhāya ceteti na para . . . pe . . . na ubhaya . . . na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.71:4.4: Mūḷho kho āvuso mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati vācāya . . . pe . . . manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.71:4.5: Mohe pahīne n' eva kāyena duccaritaṃ carati na vācāya . . . pe . . . na manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.71:4.6: Mūḷho kho āvuso mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attattham pi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti parattham pi . . . pe . . . ubhayattham pi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an3.71:4.7: Mohe pahīne attattham pi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti parattham pi . . . ubhayattham pi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an3.71:4.8: Moho kho āvuso andhakaraṇo acakkhukaraṇo aññāṇakaraṇo paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko.
an3.71:4.9: Idaṃ kho mayaṃ āvuso rāge ādīnavaṃ disvā rāgassa pahānaṃ paññāpema,
an3.71:4.10: idaṃ dose ādīnavaṃ disvā dosassa pahānaṃ paññāpema,
an3.71:4.11: idaṃ mohe ādīnavaṃ disvā mohassa pahānaṃ paññāpemā ti. 3.
an3.71:5.1: Atthi pan' āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahānāyā ti?
an3.71:5.2: Atth' āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahānāyā ti.
an3.71:5.3: Katamo pan' āvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahānāyā ti?
an3.71:5.4: Ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo seyyathīdaṃ
an3.71:5.6: Ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahānāyā ti.
an3.71:5.7: Bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahānāyā
an3.71:5.8: ti. Alañ ca pan' āvuso Ānanda appamādāyā
